description: D-340 pressure fixture — one member of the ghost swarm (cloned to ghost.fan-1..N by the pressure suite). fan.run@1 fires K concurrent calls into ghost.load@1, exercising concurrent dormant first-touch (singleflight spawn), the plugins-of-plugins chain, and — with N clones holding port:ghost.load@1 — the fan-in that makes the shared algorithm load-bearing without anyone assigning it.

capabilities.justification: Swarm member: consumes the shared algorithm (the fan-in signal) and fans concurrent calls into it.
